movie.title: Shackled
movie.overview: In a dystopian future where the parole system has been replaced with R.A.P.P. - the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program - a white collar ex-con must take drastic measures to ensure his survival when he's paired with a sociopathic gangster with terminal cancer. One wrong move by either of them could mean the summary execution of them both, via the explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts as a condition of their release.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a bleak dystopian future, a white-collar ex-con is forced into a deadly partnership with a sociopathic, terminally ill gangster via heart-implanted explosives.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In a dystopian society, the traditional parole system is replaced by R.A.P.P., pairing paroled convicts together with explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts. A white-collar ex-con finds himself tethered to a sociopathic gangster with terminal cancer whose imminent death could trigger mutual destruction. To survive the extreme system, he must take drastic and dangerous measures before time runs out. Every move becomes a high-stakes gamble where one mistake guarantees summary execution for both.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a grim dystopian future, the justice system replaces standard parole with the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program (R.A.P.P.), a ruthless initiative designed to enforce compliance. Under this system, paroled convicts are paired together and surgically fitted with explosive charges in their hearts that detonate if either party steps out of line or dies. The story follows a mild-mannered white-collar ex-con trying to peacefully reintegrate into society while forced into this involuntary partnership. Tension skyrockets when he discovers his assigned partner is a ruthless, sociopathic gangster suffering from terminal cancer. Knowing that his partner's natural death will trigger his own instant execution, the ex-con is forced into an escalating struggle for self-preservation. Navigating a lethal web of gang violence, systemic corruption, and volatile personal conflict, he must find a way to manipulate the system and neutralize the threat. As mistrust and desperation build between the two mismatched men, every decision carries life-or-death consequences. Ultimately, he must take extreme, unthinkable measures to untether himself before his partner's ticking clock runs out completely.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in a harsh, speculative future where criminal justice has evolved into a brutal experiment, Shackled explores the lethal consequences of the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program (R.A.P.P.). Under R.A.P.P., state-enforced probation links two former convicts together using heart-implanted explosive devices, ensuring that any violation or death results in immediate, double execution. When a white-collar offender attempting to rebuild his life is paired with an unhinged, terminally ill gangster, the tension becomes a pressure cooker of survival. Facing an inevitable countdown due to his partner's failing health, the ex-con must navigate psychological warfare, underworld threats, and an unyielding legal system in a desperate bid to survive.

story_structure.climax: A catastrophic crisis forces the ex-con to directly confront his partner's chaotic choices and the brutal reality of the R.A.P.P. system, pushing their shared life line to its absolute breaking point.
story_structure.conflict: The protagonist must navigate daily survival alongside a volatile, sociopathic partner whose ruthless tendencies and declining health constantly threaten to trigger the automated summary execution mechanism for both of them.
story_structure.resolution: The intense ordeal reaches its conclusion, forever altering the protagonist's outlook on freedom, survival, and the dark cost of the state's total control mechanism.
story_structure.introduction: In a dystopian future, a non-violent ex-con enters the R.A.P.P. parole program and is forced to share a physical, life-or-death tether via implanted cardiac explosives with an unpredictable, terminally ill gangster.
story_structure.risingAction: As high-stakes criminal friction and escalating external threats push the mismatched pair into perilous situations, trust becomes impossible while mutual survival demands tight synchronization and extreme desperate measures.
